$comment: The `members` binding is an InferOpsMembersSession from the inferops gatekeeper (custom-gatekeepers/gatekeeper-inferops). blueprintId is the install key: never rename it.
title: InferOps Members
description: Use to view who holds access to one InferOps workspace, read-only: each member's name, kind, role and explicitly denied permissions, without email addresses. Needs one InferOps workspace member list connected as the `members` binding. The connection is private to the person who made it, so a gadget using it cannot be shared.

members.title: InferOps workspace members
members.description: The InferOps workspace whose members this gadget shows, e.g. inferops://demo.local/portal/members.
